data.narrative:
PsiQuantum is a private-stage quantum computing company currently valued at $7.0B, having raised $1.0B to date. The valuation assessment relies on a peer-median triangulation across six same-sector comparables spanning both public and private quantum computing firms, including Quantinuum (Series G, $14.8B), IonQ (public, $13.0B), D-Wave Quantum (public, $6.3B), SandboxAQ (Series E, $5.8B), and Rigetti Computing (public, $4.5B).

The peer-median method yields an implied valuation of $6.0B, derived from the median across the six-company comparable set. The peer range spans $1.9B at the floor to $14.8B at the ceiling, reflecting material dispersion within the quantum computing sector. This median of $6.0B anchors the triangulated analysis, as it represents the most robust available methodological input.

The triangulated valuation range is $5.1B (low) to $6.9B (median), with $6.0B as the central point estimate. PsiQuantum's current $7.0B valuation sits modestly above this derived range. Key uncertainties include the wide peer dispersion—a 7.7x spread from Rigetti to Quantinuum—and reliance on a single valuation method, reflecting limited transparency in private quantum computing cap tables. The analysis supports a valuation range of $5.1B–$6.9B, though execution risk and technology differentiation remain material drivers of outlier outcomes.
